name: gunzip
description: Restores a file compressed by gzip and removes the .gz, unless -k is used. It is the same as gzip -d. For a .tar.gz archive, use tar -xzf directly instead, which decompresses and extracts in one step. To read a .gz without decompressing it to disk, there are zcat and zless.

options.description: Writes the decompressed contents to standard output, without creating a file.
Overwrites an existing file with the same name.
Checks the integrity of the compressed file.
Shows the sizes and compression ratio.
Decompresses the files in directories, recursively.
Prints the name and ratio of each file.

examples.explanation: Searches a compressed log without decompressing it to disk.
